description: This file defines an Android Fragment (SettingsFragment) responsible for displaying a settings menu with clickable items (Account, Network, About), each responding with Toast feedback. It handles view creation, item initialization, styling, and focus change behavior.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of settings options (Account, Network, About) with focus and click interactions, providing visual feedback and Toast messages.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list of TextView items, applies styling, and sets click and focus change listeners to provide feedback.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of SettingsFragment.
